newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss SMI index extends drop below 5,300.
newsitem.headline: Swiss SMI index extends drop below 5,300.

text.p: The Swiss Market Index of blue-chip stocks extended early losses to dip below the 5,300-point level on the back of Wall Street's selloff on Friday.
The SMI recovered a bit to be down 180.8 points, or 3.29 percent, at 5,317.7 around 12 minutes after the exchange opened. But prices then fell again to around 5,297.4.
Swiss traders noted that the SMI had already gone through a six percent correction last week.
